title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Convert a temperature given in Celsius `C` to Fahrenheit `F` using `F = (C * 9 / 5) + 32` and print the result formatted to 2 decimal places.
instructions: Read Celsius temperature `C` as a float/double.
hints: Be careful with integer division in Java: use `9.0 / 5.0` instead of `9 / 5`.
Format the final float to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
c = float(input().strip())
# Convert to Fahrenheit and print to 2 decimal places
